text:
eli_sales: Heads-up — GlobalBank wants a 6-week on-prem POC in an air-gapped DC. Main asks: signed bundles, offline KMS/HSM integration, SBOM, upgrade cadence (they want quarterly with emergency hotfixes), and reserved-node pricing for the pilot. Who can pair on technical presales?

nina_se: I can take SE lead. quick q: target model(s) + GPU count? also will they allow USB or only signed media via courier?

eli_sales: They're strict: no external internet, no USB unless whitelisted and scanned. Model set: Llama2-70B equivalent and a smaller 13B for baseline. Initially 2 x A100-ish GPUs for perf tests, may ramp.

sam_security: Flagging requirements: full telemetry opt-out, disk-level encryption, SBOM attached to bundles, and signed images with chain-of-trust verification. We need the customer's root CA to verify bundle signatures in their airgap. Also HSM/KMS integration — do they want us to call their KMS or have offline keywrap?

nina_se: For offline KMS we support keywrap + local keystore with CMK import via HSM. We'll need to produce a key-import guide for their HSM model.

maria_eng: Packaging note: we can produce two artifact types: full image (operator + weights) and quantized delta bundle (weights compressed + loader). Delta bundles cut bytes but require exact operator version. We maintain compatibility matrix per operator version.

eli_sales: Customer asked about upgrade cadence guarantees. They want quarterly feature updates + security hotfixes within 2 weeks. Is that doable?

maria_eng: Quarterly feature rollouts doable for Dedicated builds. Hotfixes: we can commit to critical-security patches signed + a backported hotfix build within 14 days for the pilot if we schedule a maintenance window. Need to confirm SLA in SOW.

sam_security: Also need to confirm logging: logs must stay on-prem and we must support a local metrics export (Prometheus pushgateway allowed) — no outbound telemetry to our hosted backplane.

eli_sales: Understood. Can we get a minimal runbook + sample commands for their infra team to validate install/verify signatures?

nina_se: Draft runbook (short):

```
# offline install (example)
scp signed-bundle.tar.gz jumpbox:/tmp
ssh jumpbox
# verify signature (we bundle our public cert and verify against their root CA)
redwood-offline verify --bundle /tmp/signed-bundle.tar.gz --ca /etc/pki/customer-root.crt
redwood-offline install --bundle /tmp/signed-bundle.tar.gz --local-keystore /opt/redwood/keystore
# start operator
kubectl apply -f redwood-operator.yaml
```

nina_se: We'll attach SBOM and signature metadata in the release payload. The customer will need to enable signature verification using the provided CLI.

zoe_legal: For the security questionnaire: I can run through the standard enterprise packet but need 5 business days to complete responses and coordinate with infra for attestation. Also they asked about indemnity clauses and export controls — pass to commercial.

eli_sales: I'll loop in procurement/commercial separately. Any blockers from engineering regarding packaging or supported features for this POC?

maria_eng: Two things: (1) quantized bundles require pinned operator versions — we'll give them a compatibility matrix and SHA hashes. (2) If they want offline model caching between nodes (shared cache), that's supported via NFS in their DC but we need network paths defined.

sam_security: One more: key custody. If they insist on HSM-only signing for their side, we can support verifying HSM-signed customer keys, but we can't sign artifacts with their HSM. If they want mutual signing, we need legal to approve trust model.

deploy-bot: build 2024-04-15T12:03:12Z: offline-signed-bundle v1.0.0 created (sha256: a3f4...9c2). SBOM attached.

eli_sales: Great. Next steps I propose: (1) SE -> draft runbook + compatibility matrix (nina/maria) (2) Security -> answer questionnaire + key custody note (sam/zoe) (3) Sales -> send SOW template + ask for customer root CA and HSM model, and confirm maintenance windows. I'll set target: have materials to the customer within 3 business days. :thumbsup:

nina_se: I'll start the runbook and include the CLI snippets + verification steps.

maria_eng: I'll export the operator-compat matrix and quantized bundle caveats.

sam_security: I'll start the questionnaire answers, will flag any items that need customer attestations.

eli_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer once we have artifacts. tagging @nina_se @sam_security @maria_eng for follow-ups.

eli_sales: (action) I'll push customer contact + expected HSM model by EOD.

zoe_legal: Acknowledged, will standby for contract SOW edits.

eli_sales: Closing note — customer asked for a pricing ballpark for a 6-week reserved pilot (2x A100 equiv) plus engineering support. Can finance give a typical pilot rate we can ping them with?

nina_se: ballpark: monthly reserved node + 40 hrs eng support + SOW — will draft numbers and hand to sales for final.

eli_sales: Perfect. I'll follow up with a summary email to the customer once we have docs.
